chunks.subject: AP Physics 2
chunks.title: Q2 Translation Between Representations (TBR) — 12 points
chunks.content: AP Physics 2 FRQ 2 is Translation Between Representations (TBR), 12 points, scored by lettered sub-points. The TBR task requires moving among words, equations, graphs, diagrams, and data and keeping them consistent. Q2 topic: an ideal gas — pressure, volume, and energy (thermodynamic process, e.g., a PV diagram). Points reward: correct PV-diagram or process representation, correct equations (ideal gas law, first law of thermodynamics), correctly labeled graphs, and quantitative results consistent across representations. Common failure: mislabeled PV axes or wrong process path; sign errors in work/heat; an equation inconsistent with the diagram.

chunks.content: Q2 (TBR) scored 12/12 — all representations correct and consistent: PV diagram/process, thermodynamic equations, labeled graphs, and agreeing quantitative results. Full-credit model.

chunks.title: Q2 exemplar — Sample 2B, 9/12
chunks.content: Q2 (TBR) scored 9/12 — earned most representation points but lost a few, commonly a graph feature or a sign error in the first-law energy accounting. Illustrates a strong response with a couple of translation slips.

chunks.subject: AP Physics 2
chunks.title: Q2 exemplar — Sample 2C, 5/12
chunks.content: Q2 (TBR) scored 5/12 — earned under half the representation points, losing much of the graph/equation translation and the consistent quantitative results. Illustrates a response that handles some representations but cannot keep them consistent.
